# Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggalluvial)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

# Load data

```{r}
#hpa_data_v25 <- read_csv("data/hpa_evidence_v25.csv")
hpa_data <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.24/hpa_data_v24.csv")
head(hpa_data)

tissue_data <- read_tsv("../data/HPA v.24/rna_tissue_consensus.tsv")

uniprot_info <- read_tsv("../data/UniProt/uniprot_mapping_2025_05_26.tsv")
head(uniprot_info)
```

# Plots

## Sankey: Comparing HPA and UniProt evidence

```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 10}
# Step 1: Prepare categorized evidence for Sankey plot
sankey_data <- hpa_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Ensembl, Uniprot, `HPA evidence`) %>%
  full_join(uniprot_info %>% dplyr::select(Entry, `Protein existence`), by = c("Uniprot" = "Entry")) %>%
  # Switch UniProt evidence for Protein existence
  dplyr::rename(`UniProt evidence` = `Protein existence`) %>%
  mutate(
    HPA = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(`HPA evidence`) ~ "NA",
      TRUE ~ `HPA evidence`
    ),
    UniProt = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(`UniProt evidence`) ~ "NA",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Inferred from homology" ~ "PE3: Inferred from homology",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Predicted" ~ "PE4: Predicted",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Uncertain" ~ "PE5: Uncertain",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Evidence at protein level" ~ "PE1: Evidence at protein level",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Evidence at transcript level" ~ "PE2: Evidence at transcript level",
      TRUE ~ `UniProt evidence`
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(HPA != "NA") |>
  count(HPA, UniProt, name = "Freq")

# Step 2: Define colors for each evidence category
hpa_colors <- c(
  "Evidence at protein level" = "darkgreen",
  "Evidence at transcript level" = "darkorange",
  "No human protein/transcript evidence" = "firebrick",
  "NA" = "#999999"
)
uniprot_colors <- c(
  "PE1: Evidence at protein level" = "darkgreen",
  "PE2: Evidence at transcript level" = "darkorange",
  "PE3: Inferred from homology" = "#cccccc",  # light gray
  "PE4: Predicted"              = "#888888",  # medium gray
  "PE5: Uncertain"              = "#444444",  # dark gray
  "NA"                          = "#111111"   # almost black
)
# Combine for scale
evidence_colors <- c(hpa_colors, uniprot_colors)

# Step 3: Plot Sankey with coloring by HPA category (flows) and by stratum (bar)

# After count() step
sankey_data <- sankey_data %>%
  mutate(
    UniProt = factor(
      UniProt,
      levels = c("PE1: Evidence at protein level", "PE2: Evidence at transcript level", "PE3: Inferred from homology", "PE4: Predicted", "PE5: Uncertain", "NA")
    )
  )

# Calculate label with count for HPA and UniProt
sankey_data_label <- sankey_data %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(HPA, UniProt),
    names_to = "axis",
    values_to = "stratum"
  ) %>%
  group_by(axis, stratum) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(Freq), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(stratum, "\n(", count, ")"))

# Sankey plot
ggplot(sankey_data,
       aes(axis1 = HPA, axis2 = UniProt, y = Freq)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = HPA), width = 0.4, alpha = 0.8, color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  geom_stratum(aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)), width = 0.5, color = "black") +
  # Custom labels with count below the stratum name
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(
      label = after_stat(
        paste0(stratum, "\n(", ..count.., ")")
      )
    ),
    size = 4,
    vjust = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("HPA Evidence", "UniProt Evidence"),
    expand = c(0.05, 0.05)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = evidence_colors, na.value = "#999999") +
  labs(
    title = "Sankey Plot of HPA and UniProt Evidence Categories",
    y = "Number of Genes",
    fill = "Evidence Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3A.pdf", width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3A.png", width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

## Sankey: Highlighting only genes that have no UniProt evidence

```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7}
# Prepare data for Sankey
sankey_data <- hpa_data %>%
  select(Ensembl, Uniprot, `HPA evidence`) %>%
  full_join(
    uniprot_info %>% select(Entry, `Protein existence`),
    by = c("Uniprot" = "Entry")
  ) %>%
  rename(`UniProt evidence` = `Protein existence`) %>%
  mutate(
    HPA = case_when(
      is.na(`HPA evidence`) ~ "NA",
      TRUE ~ `HPA evidence`
    ),
    UniProt = case_when(
      is.na(`UniProt evidence`) ~ "NA",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Inferred from homology" ~ "PE3: Inferred from homology",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Predicted" ~ "PE4: Predicted",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Uncertain" ~ "PE5: Uncertain",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Evidence at protein level" ~ "PE1: Evidence at protein level",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Evidence at transcript level" ~ "PE2: Evidence at transcript level",
      TRUE ~ `UniProt evidence`
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    UniProt %in% c(
      "PE3: Inferred from homology",
      "PE4: Predicted",
      "PE5: Uncertain",
      "NA"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(HPA != "NA") %>%
  filter(HPA != "No human protein/transcript evidence") %>%
  count(HPA, UniProt, name = "Freq")

# Set color palettes
hpa_colors <- c(
  "Evidence at protein level" = "darkgreen",
  "Evidence at transcript level" = "darkorange",
  "No human protein/transcript evidence" = "firebrick",
  "NA" = "#999999"
)
uniprot_colors <- c(
  "PE3: Inferred from homology" = "#cccccc",
  "PE4: Predicted"              = "#888888",
  "PE5: Uncertain"              = "#444444",
  "NA"                          = "#111111"
)
evidence_colors <- c(hpa_colors, uniprot_colors)

# Order UniProt factor levels for better plotting
sankey_data <- sankey_data %>%
  mutate(
    UniProt = factor(
      UniProt,
      levels = c(
        "PE3: Inferred from homology",
        "PE4: Predicted",
        "PE5: Uncertain",
        "NA"
      )
    )
  )

total_genes <- sum(sankey_data$Freq)

ggplot(sankey_data,
       aes(
         axis1 = UniProt,
         axis2 = HPA,
         y     = Freq
       )
) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = HPA),
                width = 0.4, alpha = 0.8,
                color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  geom_stratum(aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)),
               width = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = after_stat(paste0(stratum, "\n(", ..count.., ")"))),
    size = 4, vjust = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("UniProt", "HPA"),
    labels = c("UniProt Evidence", "HPA Evidence"),
    expand = c(0.05, 0.05)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = evidence_colors, na.value = "#999999") +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("HPA contributing genes v.24 (n = %d)", total_genes),
    y     = "Number of Genes",
    fill  = "Evidence Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3B.pdf", width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3B.png", width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

## Sankey: Tissue specificity

```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7}
# ---- 1. Re-factor tissue specificity in the desired order ----
desired_tissue_levels <- c(
  "Tissue enriched",
  "Group enriched",
  "Tissue enhanced",
  "Low tissue specificity",
  "Not detected"
)

sankey_data <- sankey_data %>%
  mutate(
    `RNA tissue specificity` = factor(
      `RNA tissue specificity`,
      levels = desired_tissue_levels
    )
  )

# ---- 2. Build your colour vectors ----
hpa_evidence_colors <- c(
  "Evidence at protein level"    = "darkgreen",
  "Evidence at transcript level" = "darkorange",
  "No evidence"                  = "firebrick"
)

tissue_spec_colors <- c(
  "Tissue enriched"         = "#E31A1B",
  "Group enriched"          = "#FE9D00",
  "Tissue enhanced"         = "#B65EC4",
  "Low tissue specificity"  = "#7D7D7D",
  "Not detected"            = "#E4E4E4"
)

all_colors <- c(hpa_evidence_colors, tissue_spec_colors)

# ---- 3. Draw the Sankey with HPA on the left, tissue on the right ----
p <- ggplot(
  sankey_data,
  aes(
    axis1 = `HPA evidence`,
    axis2 = `RNA tissue specificity`,
    y     = Freq
  )
) +
  # alluvia coloured by the HPA evidence
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = `HPA evidence`),
                width = 0.3, alpha = 0.8,
                color = "gray50", size = 0.2) +
  # strata on both sides, each side uses the same fill mapping
  geom_stratum(aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)),
               width = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum",
            aes(label = after_stat(paste0(stratum, "\n(", ..count.., ")"))),
            size = 4, vjust = 1.2) +
  # label the two axes in the correct order
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("HPA Evidence", "RNA Tissue Specificity"),
    name   = NULL,
    expand = c(.05, .05)
  ) +
  # supply the unified palette
  scale_fill_manual(values = all_colors) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("HPA evidence → RNA tissue specificity\n(n = %d genes)", sum(sankey_data$Freq)),
    y     = "Number of Genes",
    fill  = "Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title      = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

# display
print(p)

# ---- 4. Save ----
ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3E.pdf", p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3E.png", p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

## UMAP: 

### HPA contributing genes

```{r}
hpa_contributing_tissue_detected_genes <- hpa_data %>%
  select(Ensembl, Uniprot, `HPA evidence`) %>%
  full_join(
    uniprot_info %>% select(Entry, `Protein existence`),
    by = c("Uniprot" = "Entry")
  ) %>%
  rename(`UniProt evidence` = `Protein existence`) %>%
  mutate(
    HPA = case_when(
      is.na(`HPA evidence`) ~ "NA",
      TRUE ~ `HPA evidence`
    ),
    UniProt = case_when(
      is.na(`UniProt evidence`) ~ "NA",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Inferred from homology" ~ "PE3: Inferred from homology",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Predicted" ~ "PE4: Predicted",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Uncertain" ~ "PE5: Uncertain",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Evidence at protein level" ~ "PE1: Evidence at protein level",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Evidence at transcript level" ~ "PE2: Evidence at transcript level",
      TRUE ~ `UniProt evidence`
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    UniProt %in% c(
      "PE3: Inferred from homology",
      "PE4: Predicted",
      "PE5: Uncertain",
      "NA"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(HPA != "NA") %>%
  filter(HPA != "No human protein/transcript evidence") |>
  inner_join(hpa_data |> select(Ensembl, `RNA tissue specificity`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  filter(`RNA tissue specificity` != "Not detected")

umap_data <- tissue_data %>%
  rename(Ensembl = Gene) |>
  filter(Ensembl %in% hpa_contributing_tissue_detected_genes$Ensembl) |>
  inner_join(hpa_data |> select(Ensembl, `HPA evidence`, `RNA tissue specificity`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  mutate(`RNA tissue specificity` = factor(`RNA tissue specificity`, levels = c("Tissue enriched", "Group enriched", "Tissue enhanced", "Low tissue specificity")))

library(HDAnalyzeR)

umap_hd <- hd_umap(dat = umap_data |> 
          select(Ensembl, Tissue, nTPM) |> 
          pivot_wider(names_from = Ensembl, values_from = nTPM),
        by_sample = FALSE,
        impute = TRUE,
        components = 2,
        seed = 123)

umap <- umap_hd$umap_res |>
  rename(Ensembl = Features) |>
  inner_join(umap_data, by = "Ensembl")
```

```{r}
p_umap <- ggplot(umap |> distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE), aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = `RNA tissue specificity`, shape = `HPA evidence`)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 18, 15)) + # Circle, Triangle, Square, Diamond
  labs(
    title = "UMAP of HPA Contributing Genes",
    x = "UMAP1",
    y = "UMAP2",
    color = "RNA Tissue Specificity",
    shape = "HPA Evidence"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title      = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

p_umap

#ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 2/Figure 2F.png", p_umap, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
max_tissue_per_gene <- umap %>% 
  # your big tibble
  group_by(Ensembl) %>%          # group by gene (you can drop Gene_name if you don’t need it)
  slice_max(nTPM, with_ties = FALSE) %>%    # take the single row with highest nTPM
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(Ensembl, Tissue, nTPM) %>% 
  rename(
    `Max tissue` = Tissue,
    `Max nTPM`   = nTPM
  )

p_umap <- ggplot(umap |> distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
                   inner_join(max_tissue_per_gene, by = "Ensembl"), 
                 aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = `Max tissue`, shape = `HPA evidence`)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "UMAP of HPA Contributing Genes",
    x = "UMAP1",
    y = "UMAP2",
    color = "RNA Tissue Specificity",
    shape = "HPA Evidence"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title      = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

p_umap

max_tissue_per_gene |>
  # count max tissue
  count(`Max tissue`, name = "Number of genes") |>
  arrange(desc(`Number of genes`))
```
